_note: THE CROSSING. One voice, because there is one person aboard who is not in the story: the hand who is steering. Everything the passengers say is in data/events/eastreach_launch.json, where it can be gated on how far into the sea they are.

lines: I have been asked four times today whether she will take it. She will take it.
Nobody has yet asked me whether I will, and I would rather they did not.
Eleven miles on this heading and then we are behind the legs of the thing.
After that I am told there is a beach. I have not met anybody who has stood on it.
